compare.pageDescription: Mobile, Internet, Internet + TV — Select the categories you want to compare. 5 steps, takes 5 minutes.
compare.heading: Which plan would you like to compare?
compare.supportNote: We currently support comparisons of telecommunications providers in Belgium (BE). The Netherlands (NL) and Luxembourg (LU) will be added in Phase 3.
compare.savingsPreviewPending: The "Average Savings" preview will be available after the beta period.
compare.termsNoticeEnd: You are deemed to have consented (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) – Necessity for the performance of a contract).

postal.title: Enter your ZIP code
postal.heading: Where do you live?
postal.supportNote: Select a country and enter your ZIP code. We currently support comparisons for Belgium (BE). There may be no providers available for comparison in the Netherlands (NL) and Luxembourg (LU) until Phase 5 providers are added.

BE.label: Belgium (BE)
BE.description: Belgian postal codes consist of four digits ranging from 1000 to 9999.

NL.label: Netherlands (NL)
NL.description: Dutch postal codes consist of either four digits (PC4) or four digits followed by a space and two uppercase letters (PC6). Comparison candidates will be added in Phase 5.

LU.label: Luxembourg (LU)
LU.description: Luxembourg postal codes consist of four digits ranging from 1000 to 9999. Comparison candidates will be added in Phase 5.

household.heading: How are you doing?
household.supportNote: If you select a household type, we will estimate your average usage. Your exact usage will be automatically entered in Phase 3 using bill OCR.

family_3_plus.label: Family
family_3_plus.description: Households with three or more members

currentProvider.heading: Where are you using it right now?
currentProvider.supportNote: Selecting a provider at this stage improves the accuracy of the comparison, but it is not required. If you're unsure or a new user, you can skip this step.
currentProvider.zeroProvidersFallback: We were unable to load the list of providers. Would you like to proceed as a new user? The comparison results will be calculated based on all available options in the market.
currentProvider.tariffNotRegistered: This provider's active plans have not yet been registered (to be added in Phase 5).
currentProvider.tariffUnknown: I'm not familiar with this provider's rate plan (comparing providers only)
currentProvider.skipButton: I don't know / Skip — Proceed as a new subscriber case

bill.heading: Would you like to upload your bill to automatically enter your exact usage?
bill.supportNote: Currently in beta — Invoice OCR will be added immediately after the Phase 3 results page. For now, comparisons are based on estimates derived from household composition.
bill.skipButton: No invoice required — Preview the results

preview.heading: Results are being prepared
preview.supportNote: We are generating a permalink for the comparison results based on the information you entered. Once complete, you will be automatically redirected to the results page.
preview.submittingMessage: Calling the comparison engine... (usually takes less than 1 second)
preview.inputIncomplete: Your entry is incomplete. Please return to the ZIP code or household type step.
preview.networkError: A network error has occurred. Please try again.

result.pageDescription: Benelux Mobile Plan Comparison Results — Slim
result.heading: Comparison Results
result.anonymizedNote: The input assumptions for this comparison have been generalized to a 90-day retention policy—the comparison results themselves remain unchanged (ADR-0007 §T9).
result.noCandidatesHeading: There are no candidates to compare.
result.noCandidatesBody: There are currently no comparable suppliers in this category/region. The addition of an NL/LU supplier fetcher is scheduled to proceed following an evaluation in Phase 5 (ADR-0009 § Decision 1).
result.dataSourcesLink: View details on the data source page →
result.affiliateFooterEnd: (Scheduled for release in Phase 6.9). The ranking in the comparison results is algorithm-based and is not influenced by fees.

verdicts.newSubscriber: This is the most affordable plan for new subscribers.
verdicts.zero: It is the same as your current plan.
verdicts.negative: We couldn't find any plans cheaper than your current one — we recommend keeping it.

confidenceLabels.medium: Reliability: Moderate — Data sources need to be reviewed
confidenceLabels.low: Low reliability — Automatically excluded by comparison engines

table.emptyMessage: There are no results matching your criteria. Please adjust the filters above.

calculationDetails.summary: View calculation basis — Assumptions used + Formula + Notes on triggers + Engine version
calculationDetails.anonymizedWarning: These results are based on data from 90 days after storage, when the original input (postal codes, usage data, etc.) is no longer available due to retention policies. The comparison results themselves are preserved as is, and the values below have been reconstructed based on household type (ADR-0007 §T9).

assumptions.heading: Assumptions
assumptions.usageSourceAnonymized: Original data not available (90-day retention policy) — {version}

calculationDetails.usageEmpty: No usage data available (estimated household type used).
calculationDetails.triggerNote: We re-evaluated each rule based on the stored rate plan data and usage assumptions (ADR-0010 §T6).
calculationDetails.engineNote: The permanent link is reproduced in this version (ADR-0010 §T7 + ADR-0007 §T9).

notFound.heading: This result no longer exists
notFound.body: The link may have been entered incorrectly, or the results may have expired. If you start a new comparison, a permanent link will be generated again.

excludedProviders.heading: Suppliers excluded from the comparison
excludedProviders.body: The following suppliers were not included in this comparison. The reasons are disclosed as per the master data (Constitution §3 P3). You can view the same data in tabular format on the /data-sources page.

betaBanner.heading: Beta phase: Estimated values
betaBanner.body: The price is an estimate manually verified by the operator on May 9, 2026. Real-time pricing is scheduled to be implemented after Phase 5.

affiliateDisclosure.noCommissionDetail: Slim does not receive any commission from this supplier. You will be redirected directly to an external link.
affiliateDisclosure.commissionUnknown: Slim receives a commission from {providerName} when you make a change (rate undisclosed — unregistered). This commission does not affect your fees.
affiliateDisclosure.commissionKnown: Slim receives a commission from {providerName} to {amount} for this change—this amount does not affect your bill.
affiliateDisclosure.policyLink: Learn more about our fee policy
